headline: Approved revised policies on child abuse reporting, AED and CPR, and discrimination complaints; approved consent agenda.
summary: The consent agenda included staff nominations, appointments, resignations, and one transfer. Several revised policies on complaints, child abuse reporting, AED and CPR, and federal procurement were approved. The superintendent gave updates on the start of school and transportation.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 12, 2026 meeting unanimously.
Approved policy ACAA-R at first reading unanimously.
Approved policy ACAA-R2 at first reading unanimously.
Approved policy ACAB-R1 at first reading unanimously.
Approved policy ACAB-R2 at first reading unanimously.
Approved policy DJ-R, Federal Procurement Manual (2025), at first reading unanimously.
Approved amendment correcting typographical errors in policy EBCF unanimously.
Approved policy IHBAC, Child Find (2025), at first reading unanimously.
Adopted policy JLF, Child Abuse or Neglect Reporting, Prevention and Education (2026), at first and second reading unanimously.
Adopted form JLF-E, Suspected Child Abuse/Neglect Report Form, at first and second reading unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Marie Potvin moved to approve the minutes of the August 12, 2026 School Committee meeting. Amy Clearwater seconded the motion. Motion passed unanimously.
Marie Potvin moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Amy Clearwater seconded the motion. Motion passed unanimously.
ACAA-R ~ Student Discrimination and Harassment Complaint Procedure ~ Marie Potvin moved to approve the policy at first reading. Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously.
ACAA-R2 ~ Student Sex Discrimination/Harassment Complaint Procedure ~ Marie Potvin moved to approve the policy at first reading. Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously.
ACAB-R1 ~ Employee Discrimination and Harassment Complaint Procedure ~ Marie Potvin moved to approve the policy at first reading. Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously.
ACAB-R2 ~ Employee Sex Discrimination/Harassment Complaint Procedure ~Marie Potvin moved to approve the policy at first reading. Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously.

DJ-R ~ Federal Procurement Manual (2025) ~Marie Potvin moved to approve the policy at first reading. Amy Clearwater seconded. Amy Clearwater questioned the 2025 designation. It was clarified that the 2025 version is the most recently available version of the Federal Procurement Manual. Motion passed unanimously.
Marie Potvin moved to correct the typographical errors in the policy. Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion to amend passed unanimously.
IHBAC ~ Child Find (2025) ~ Marie Potvin moved to approve the policy at first reading. Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously.

JLF ~ Child Abuse or Neglect Reporting, Prevention and Education (2026) ~ Marie Potvin moved to approve the policy at first reading...The Committee voted on JLF at first and second reading. Motion passed unanimously.

JLF-E ~ Suspected Child Abuse/Neglect Report Form ~ Marie Potvin moved to approve JLF-E. Amy Clearwater seconded. Motion passed unanimously at first and second reading. Both JLF and JLF-E were therefore adopted.
